Given below is a situation followed by two conclusions. Read all the information carefully and decide which conclusion/s follow/s and mark that as your answer.Situation: Musical conditioning of babies (playing a particular kind of music while being fed) has shown to have a positive impact on their overall growth. This impact is stronger on babies aged between 0 and 8 months than on those aged between 9 and 24 months.Conclusion (I): The babies who are not fed musically do not exhibit signs of growth in one or more aspects of their lives.Conclusion (II): If two infants of the same age are musically conditioned but with different kinds of music, they both will exhibit growth traits different from each other.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Neither (I) nor (II) can be concluded.) है।
